parameters.name: ContainerGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs. The value must be a JSON-formatted string.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description:
The maximum number of ECI instances to return. The default value is 200.

> The number of instances returned is less than or equal to the specified value.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. You can get the token from the `NextToken` parameter in the response to the previous request.

parameters.name: SinceSecond
parameters.description: The time in seconds. The operation returns the status of ECI instances that were updated within this time period. This parameter is used for polling.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags attached to the ECI instance.
